risks.description: Third-party payment API (Meridian Pay) has been unreliable with intermittent timeouts and outages, potentially causing the team to miss the integration deadline for the payments module
risks.verbatim_quote: The third-party payment API from Meridian Pay has been unreliable over the past two weeks. We've seen intermittent timeouts and two complete outages. If this continues we might miss the integration deadline for the payments module
risks.speaker: Sarah Chen

risks.verbatim_quote: Our compliance audit is scheduled for October fifteenth and the auditors will want to see the encryption module fully operational by then. If the encryption module isn't complete, we'll need to request a postponement which would delay our go-live by at least a month
